methodology.baseline: 2025 complete-season FBS team data plus opponent-adjusted Ridge ratings. This is a matchup evidence report, not a 2026 score prediction.
methodology.matchupEdge: Each matchup metric compares the offense's national percentile with the opposing defense's national percentile for the corresponding allowed metric. A gap of at least 15 percentile points is labeled an advantage; smaller gaps are labeled EVEN.
methodology.ranking: National ranks are recomputed across published FBS season rows; rank 1 is best.
limitations: Team efficiency statistics are a 2025 baseline and do not automatically account for offseason roster or coaching changes.
Special teams are represented only indirectly through field position and possession outcomes.
Market data is context, not model truth.

market.probabilityMethod: logistic calibration of 2018-2025 clean closing spread to straight-up home result
